descriptionMarkdown:
Warlock Rune Powers are discipline-locked to Aeldari Warlocks unless the GM allows a rare relic, spirit-stone, or 
farseer intervention.
Power Level Tag Rule
Conceal Minor Warlock, Divination Bonus Action. Range 30 ft. One creature gains +1 AC against ranged attacks until 
your next turn if it has moved or is in cover.
Reveal Minor Warlock, Divination Bonus Action. Range 60 ft. One hidden or obscured creature makes a Wisdom 
save. On failure, it cannot benefit from invisibility or being hidden until your next 
turn.
Protect Standard Warlock, Telekinesis Action. Range 30 ft. One ally gains +2 AC until the start of your next turn.
Jinx Standard Warlock, Divination Action. Range 60 ft. Wisdom save. On failure, the target suffers -2 AC until the 
start of your next turn.
Quicken Standard Warlock, Biomancy Bonus Action. Range 30 ft. One ally gains +10 ft speed and may move through 
allied spaces until your next turn.
Restrain Fate Standard Warlock, Divination Reaction. When a creature within 60 ft makes an attack roll, subtract 1d4 from the 
roll.
Destructor Rune Major Warlock, Pyromancy Action. 15-ft cone. Dexterity save. Failure: 5d6 fire/radiant damage; success: half. 
Corrupted creatures take +1d6.
Fortune Thread Major Warlock, Divination Bonus Action. Range 30 ft. For 1 minute, once per round, the target may reroll 
one attack roll, saving throw, or ability check. Concentration.
